set.body: Owner: ScalaFIM image JVM IO. Required by native transactional selected-result sink/catalog bd-01KX6G9B8R86MRBZ9S8K8F5G7V and PLS Neuro selective-estimation epic. Existing Nifti.writeVol/writeVec copy complete values and allocate complete file bytes. Add a resource-owned, bounded-buffer uncompressed NIfTI-1 double writer with validated dimensions, Long byte offsets, contiguous and selected-spatial block writes, explicit background and shared header semantics. Creation must not clobber an existing target; invalid requests fail before mutation, IO failures retire the writer, and closure is deterministic. Preserve ordinary writer compatibility. This is scientific format IO, not job/publication lifecycle: callers stage paths, track expected block completeness and own atomic catalog publication. Acceptance: exact coordinate/unit/header and value checks, out-of-order sparse spatial blocks, background and IEEE value preservation, invalid dimension/index/closed/existing-target refusal, public heap-bounded large-file probe, image JVM and JS tests and relevant fit writer tests. Native archive canonical writer requires resident payload vectors; do not falsely claim it already supplies streaming selected-output publication.
set.title: Stream NIfTI result maps through bounded spatial writes
